nextOffset.description: Continuation offset or null at end.

artifactId.description: Original reference ID for the next page.

mediaType.description: MIME type; no content is executed.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the complete artifact bytes.

contentBase64.description: Base64 of this byte page; decode before concatenation.

details.description: Optional structured recovery information or original detail.

validationIssues.description: Input validation locations and failed constraints, when present.

error.description: Failure and recovery information. isError=true accompanies this result.

name: wait_for_status
description: Observe an existing Run, wiring task or service for at most 30 seconds, returning on change/terminal state. Reuse revision to wait again. Timeout never replays an action.

id.description: runId, wiringTaskId or serverId matching kind.

revision.description: Opaque revision from the preceding wait; omit for first wait.

timeoutMs.description: Bounded wait duration in milliseconds; 0 is a snapshot.

changed.description: State changed relative to supplied/initial revision.

terminal.description: Run/wiring terminal or service observation stable.

timedOut.description: Wait expired without change/terminal; action status is separate.

details.description: Optional structured recovery information or original detail.

validationIssues.description: Input validation locations and failed constraints, when present.

error.description: Failure and recovery information. isError=true accompanies this result.

name: get_tool_contract
description: Read one exact public tool contract, including gateway/SDK result shapes and recovery. Omit toolName to search/page the catalog. Copy SDK names from this contract.

toolName.description: Exact name from tools/list; omit to search.

details.description: Optional structured recovery information or original detail.

validationIssues.description: Input validation locations and failed constraints, when present.

error.description: Failure and recovery information. isError=true accompanies this result.

name: import_firmware_artifact
description: Import a USER project firmware file into a selected service's managed immutable storage. HH transfers bytes internally (up to 32 MiB), checks SHA-256 and returns the server path. Inspect the returned file before flash; BIN requires an explicit base address.

path.description: Relative USER project .bin/.hex/.ihex/.elf/.axf file; escapes and outside symlink targets rejected.

expectedSha256.description: Expected SHA-256; mismatch aborts before any transfer.

details.description: Optional structured recovery information or original detail.

validationIssues.description: Input validation locations and failed constraints, when present.

error.description: Failure and recovery information. isError=true accompanies this result.
